answer: A sponsor locks an 80-credit bond and files a key-bound sonnet for a newcomer at a marble marker. The newcomer claims an orchard plot; auditors check the marble log, and a copy, idle plot, or rented sponsor burns the bond and reputation. Sponsorship costs 40 plus 6 per extra fake: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 80,000 for a 40,000 pool. Decayed sponsors lock double next time; honest newcomers file once, pay 40, keep their sponsor.
